docs.title: Key Technical Highlights
docs.text:
• GitOps on AKS: ArgoCD managing FlashSale-Backend + AKS-SRE-Platform repos
  • Zero-Trust Identity: Workload Identity Federation — zero static secrets in K8s
  • Event-Driven Architecture: Kafka backbone for cross-service async communication
  • Observability: Prometheus + Grafana on AKS; OpenTelemetry instrumentation
  • DevSecOps: Trivy scans, 0 HIGH/CRITICAL findings across all 4 repos
  • FinOps: Scale-to-zero Container Apps, AKS node pool cost controls

Built by Tan Nguyen Binh · Contact: tanmainguyenbinh@gmail.com

docs.title: 1. Enterprise RAG Document Intelligence Platform
docs.text:
Demo: smart-doc-chatbot.pages.dev

What it does: Upload any PDF/document → AI answers questions using Corrective RAG with self-evaluation

Tech: Spring Boot 3 · React (Vite) · LangChain Python Agent · Qdrant (vector DB) · Kafka · Redis · Azure Container Apps · Cloudflare Pages

Key achievements: - Corrective RAG with LangGraph agent that self-evaluates retrieval quality - Kafka event-driven cache invalidation reducing repeated search latency 80% - 55/55 unit tests + 23/23 Kafka integration tests — all pass in CI

docs.title: 2. FlashSale Microservices + OpsBridge Observability
docs.text:
Demo: opsbridge-dashboard.pages.dev

What it does: Flash sale platform handling 50 concurrent buyers with zero inventory oversell

Tech: .NET 10 · CQRS/EventSourcing · PostgreSQL · Redis · RabbitMQ · Azure AKS · GitOps/ArgoCD

Key achievements: - Concurrency-safe inventory: 50 simultaneous buyers, stock=10 → exactly 10 orders, 0 oversell - 172/172 unit tests PASS, 0 HIGH/CRITICAL Trivy findings - OpsBridge observability dashboard with real-time metrics via SignalR

docs.title: 3. Quản Lý Kho Trà Sữa (Inventory Management)
docs.text:
Demo: quan-ly-kho-tra-sua.tanmainguyenbinh.workers.dev

What it does: Real-time inventory tracking for bubble tea shop with AI forecasting

Tech: Flutter 3.47 Web · FastAPI · PostgreSQL · MLflow · Cloudflare Workers (BFF proxy) · Google OAuth 2.0

Key achievements: - 191/191 Flutter tests PASS - AI inventory forecasting with MLflow experiment tracking - Cloudflare Worker as edge BFF proxy (zero server-side latency overhead)

docs.title: 4. AKS SRE Platform Blueprint
docs.text:
Evidence Site: aks-sre-platform.pages.dev (this site)

What it does: Production-grade Kubernetes platform on Azure with GitOps, SRE gates, and Zero-Trust identity

Tech: Terraform · Azure AKS (v1.36) · ArgoCD · Prometheus · Grafana · Workload Identity Federation

Key achievements: - 47/47 SRE gate tests PASS, 16/0 GitOps validation - Zero static secrets: Workload Identity Federation for all Azure resource access - Private ACR image pull by digest (imagePullSecrets: []) — verified on real AKS

docs.title: Technology Decisions
docs.text: Decision Choice Rationale Container Runtime AKS (eastasia) + ACA (southeastasia) AKS for GitOps workloads, ACA for scale-to-zero cost savings Registry ACR Basic SKU Managed, integrated with AKS via Kubelet Identity Identity Workload Identity Federation Zero static secrets — production security pattern Frontend Cloudflare Pages/Workers Free tier, global CDN, permanent URLs for CV Event Bus Kafka (Azure Event Hubs compatible) Enterprise async pattern for RAG ingestion GitOps ArgoCD on AKS Industry standard for K8s continuous delivery

docs.title: Workload Identity Evidence
docs.text:
Zero Static Secrets — Production Pattern

All workloads authenticate to Azure via Workload Identity Federation. No Kubernetes Secrets containing Azure credentials.

docs.title: What Was Proved

    participant Pod as K8s Pod
    participant OIDC as AKS OIDC Issuer
    participant ENTRA as Microsoft Entra ID
    participant ACR as Private ACR

    Pod->>OIDC: Request service account token
    OIDC-->>Pod: Signed JWT (iss: eastasia.oic.prod-aks.azure.com)
    Pod->>ENTRA: Exchange JWT for Azure access token
    Note over ENTRA: Federated Credential validates<br/>subject & issuer match
    ENTRA-->>Pod: Azure access token (no static secret)
    Pod->>ACR: Pull image by digest (token auth)
    ACR-->>Pod: Image layers
    Note over Pod: imagePullSecrets: [] ✅

docs.title: Incident Response Runbook
docs.text:
Production Incident Response — SRE Standard

Thời gian phản ứng: P0 < 15 phút, P1 < 1 giờ, P2 < 4 giờ

docs.title: 1. Phát Hiện Sự Cố (Detection)
docs.text:
# Kiểm tra trạng thái cluster
kubectl get nodes
kubectl get pods --all-namespaces | grep -v Running

# Kiểm tra events gần đây
kubectl get events --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' -A | tail -20

# Kiểm tra Container Apps
az containerapp show --name smartdoc-api --resource-group rg-portfolio-prod \
  --query "properties.runningStatus" -o tsv

docs.title: 2. Phân Loại Sự Cố (Classification)
docs.text: Mức Độ Tiêu Chí SLA P0 — Critical Service down, data loss risk 15 phút P1 — High Degraded performance, partial outage 1 giờ P2 — Medium Single feature broken 4 giờ P3 — Low Non-critical issue 24 giờ

docs.title: Bước 1: Acknowledge & Communicate
docs.text:
# Tạo incident channel (Slack/Teams)
# Thông báo: "Incident P{level} - {summary} - Investigating"
# Assign Incident Commander (IC)

docs.title: Bước 2: Rollback (Nếu Cần)
docs.text:
# Rollback AKS deployment
kubectl rollout undo deployment/flashsale-api -n flashsale

# Rollback Container App revision
az containerapp revision list --name smartdoc-api \
  --resource-group rg-portfolio-prod -o table

az containerapp ingress traffic set --name smartdoc-api \
  --resource-group rg-portfolio-prod \
  --revision-weight <previous-revision>=100

docs.title: Bước 3: Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
docs.text:
# Thu thập logs
kubectl logs -l app=flashsale-api -n flashsale --since=1h > incident-logs.txt

# Azure Monitor
az monitor activity-log list \
  --resource-group rg-portfolio-prod \
  --start-time $(date -u -v-1H +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) \
  -o table

docs.title: 4. Post-Incident Review
docs.text:
• Blameless postmortem trong 48h sau incident
  • Timeline đầy đủ (detection → resolution)
  • Root cause + contributing factors
  • Action items với owner và deadline
  • Cập nhật runbook nếu cần
